lastCompletedStory.title: Filing flags --fast-track / --derived-from with hard guardrails + WSJF resolution

nextStoryContext: US-002 added --fast-track and --derived-from flags to cam issue --file-local. parseIssueArgs now returns { mode:'file-local', fastTrack:boolean, derivedFrom:string[] }. createLocalIssueOnMain has a new applyFastTrackGuardrails helper that runs 4 hard guardrails (validateSpecSource + WSJF resolvability) and inherits WSJF from the first parent with wsjf when specSource==='derived' and no explicit wsjf is provided. writeIssueFile now accepts specSource/derivedFrom/wsjf and builds the entry via buildIssueEntry helper (keeps complexity under 15). The syncWorktreeIfOnMain path is preserved (CAM-142 regression guard). The three plannability predicate sites (select.ts, rank.ts, gate.ts) were NOT touched per Option Y from US-001.

officialDocsValidated.summary: All changes are in internal modules (spec.ts validators, backlog.ts reader, alloc.ts writer, issue-file.ts commands). No external library API was exercised.
